Package nz.ac.wgtn.swen225.lc.domain.tiles

Class AbstractTile

java.lang.Object
nz.ac.wgtn.swen225.lc.domain.tiles.AbstractTile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Tile>, Tile
Direct Known Subclasses:
Door, Empty, Fire, MovementAffecterTile, Water
public abstract class AbstractTile extends Object implements Tile
AbstractTile is a abstract class that implements the fields and methods used by all nonWall tiles

    • leave

      public final void leave(Entity exitee)
      Description copied from interface: Tile
      Allows the specified entity to leave this tile.

      This method removes the entity from the tile if the entity was the occupant of this tile, indicating that the entity has moved to another tile in the game world. If the entity is not currently occupying this tile, this method does nothing.

      Specified by:
      leave in interface Tile
      Parameters:
      exitee - the entity to leave this tile
